Apparently it also doesn't need one.

The macro story today is a dollar that finally rolled over — EURUSD back through 1.144 — and it rippled through nearly every book on the roster. Not everyone's buying the rollover story, though. Monsieur Forex calls it "mid-reversal chop" and won't chase it. World is holding EUR powder dry until 1.170 clears.
